_about: Card packs (src/delivery/packs.js; the spec: BLUEPRINTS-NOTES.md 'Card packs', CHECKLIST item 115). Every number here is the owner's to tune. rarities: lowest to highest, with the colour a card shows. odds: the weight of each rarity for a plain slot (rolled among the rarities the pack's pool has cards of; a rarity with no cards in the pool is skipped and its share goes to the others). ladder: the rarity of a garage car's blueprint card by its star tier (gold / blue, tiers 1 to 5; null = no cards, the 1-gold starters); a car's own `rarity` field is read first (the promoted idea-lot cars: epic, or legendary); goldOneBlueprint: the card of a 1-gold BLUEPRINT car (evergreen, starts locked), which must be obtainable. featuredRarity: the rarity a featured blueprint card shows when its car has no card rarity of its own (no `rarity`, no tier); otherwise a featured card keeps its TRUE rarity (a featured Uncommon is Uncommon: the owner, 12-Oct), and a featured key is Bespoke. doubleChance: the chance each NON-featured card that drops DOUBLES its stack (n = base x 2), rolled a slot (the owner, 12-Oct; a kind's own `doubleChance` overrides it); never a key (always 1), never a featured card (its own amount). kinds: size = cards a pack; baseAmount = how many copies of its card every non-featured slot gives before any doubling (a whole number >= 1: 1 for the normal packs, 2 for the LIMITED ones); amounts (optional) = { rarity: n } over baseAmount for that rarity; limited: true = a LIMITED pack (an event's / featured pack: the special kind today; the owner may add others), which gives baseAmount 2; pool 'evergreen' = every card that is always in the pool (the garage cars by the ladder, the evergreen blueprint cars; never an event car, never a key), 'all' = evergreen plus Bespoke keys (the keys of the Bespoke key cars, cars.js `bespoke: true`, not owned yet); bespokeBlueprints: true = the Bespoke key cars' blueprints (Legendary, their `rarity`) are in the pack's pool too, in their rarity (never evergreen: a career pack has none; a special pack gets its event's as featured cards); atLeast = { rarity: n }: the pack holds at least n cards of that rarity or better (the last slots are rolled again to make it so); featured (special packs): upgradeChance = the chance each slot but the last upgrades; featuredChance = the chance EACH featured card is hit when a slot upgrades (each its own roll; one card a slot); the last slot is always a featured card (a guaranteed featured card, of its true rarity: no Epic-or-better promise), picked BY WEIGHT among the featured entries (events.json featured: a car id is weight 1, or { car, weight, amount, key }); an upgraded slot picks among the entries hit by weight; in the featured slots an entry the player has exhausted (car at max ECU, key owned) is out and the others' weights shift. career: which Career levels give a career pack the first time they are delivered: every = every nth level of the main list (the tiers in order, then the levels outside them, no races, no events), plus the ids in levels. events: what a special event gives: stage = a pack for each stage done the first time, prize = a pack with the grand prize (null: none); featured (optional) = the featured list of a special pack from no event, in the events.json form (left out: every event car at weight 1). log: how many opened packs the save keeps (what each held).
